localities.name: Sholinganallur
localities.price_note: Apartments; premium gated communities toward upper end
localities.trend_note: OMR corridor apartment prices rose roughly 8-10% over the past year; Sholinganallur is the corridor's most established IT-adjacent hub with housing from about Rs 6,000/sqft upward.
demand_drivers: ELCOT IT SEZ and OMR IT campuses
Proximity to Siruseri SIPCOT IT Park
localities.supply_note: Large ongoing supply along OMR; absorption strong from IT workforce, but South Chennai holds ~57% of the city's unsold inventory
localities.flood_note: Marsh-adjacent stretches waterlogged in 2015/2023; within NGT's Sept 2025 1-km Pallikaranai Ramsar scrutiny zone

localities.name: Navalur
localities.price_note: Apartments; average around Rs 6,400-7,500/sqft in 2025 listings
localities.trend_note: Mid-OMR hub with average rates around Rs 6,400/sqft and new launches quoting Rs 7,500/sqft; corridor appreciation of 8-10% annually reported.
demand_drivers: IT parks (Gateway Office Parks, campuses between Sholinganallur and Siruseri)
Strong tenant base of IT professionals
localities.supply_note: Heavy new apartment supply from large developers; healthy absorption
localities.flood_note: Some low-lying pockets; named in NGT Pallikaranai-buffer scrutiny list

localities.name: Siruseri
localities.price_note: Apartments; sources vary between ~Rs 4,500 entry rates and ~Rs 6,400 averages for newer projects
localities.trend_note: Anchored by SIPCOT IT Park (TCS Siruseri among India's largest campuses); prices lower than Sholinganallur/Navalur, appreciating with corridor-wide 8-10% momentum.
demand_drivers: Planned metro Phase II terminus (Corridor 3 to SIPCOT)
localities.supply_note: Significant new launch pipeline; still an emerging micro-market

localities.name: Kelambakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments mostly Rs 4,000-6,500/sqft; plotted land generally cheaper per sqft (~Rs 2,500-4,500)
localities.trend_note: South-OMR affordable node (rates broadly up to ~Rs 4,500/sqft at entry level per 99acres-cited data) benefiting from OMR spillover and the Kelambakkam-Vandalur link road; corridor appreciation ~8-10%.
demand_drivers: Chettinad Health City and educational institutions
localities.supply_note: Ample apartment and plotted supply; buyer's-market pricing at entry level

localities.name: Padur
localities.price_note: Apartments; estimated band between Siruseri and Kelambakkam levels
localities.trend_note: Emerging south-OMR locality between Navalur and Kelambakkam with large integrated townships; rides corridor-level 8-10% annual appreciation (locality band estimated from corridor data).
demand_drivers: Large township projects improving social infrastructure
localities.supply_note: Township-scale supply; steady absorption

localities.name: Thoraipakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; premium projects push the top of the band
localities.trend_note: North-OMR established locality priced above the corridor average (premium listings Rs 42 lakh to Rs 3+ crore); close to Perungudi/Taramani employment and Pallikaranai marsh edge.
demand_drivers: Proximity to Tidel Park/Taramani and OMR IT offices
Radial Road connectivity to GST Road
Established rental market for IT professionals
localities.supply_note: Dense existing stock; limited large land parcels, NGT buffer restricting new approvals near marsh
localities.flood_note: East-of-OMR and marsh-adjacent pockets flooded in past events; in NGT 1-km Ramsar scrutiny zone

localities.name: Chromepet
localities.price_note: Apartments; established mid-market
localities.trend_note: Established GST Road suburb with airport and rail access; GST Road corridor apartment prices appreciated a modest ~2.9% in the last year per 99acres, with Chromepet at the pricier established end.
localities.supply_note: Mature, land-constrained market; mostly redevelopment and small projects

localities.name: Tambaram
localities.price_note: Apartments; mid-segment ~Rs 4,500-6,000/sqft core with newer projects higher
localities.trend_note: Mid-segment hub (cited around Rs 3,850-6,000/sqft depending on pocket) with steady rather than sharp appreciation; corporation upgrade and rail terminal plans support demand.
demand_drivers: Major suburban rail junction / new terminal plans
Affordability vs south Chennai IT corridor
localities.supply_note: Steady supply in East/West Tambaram and peripheries
localities.flood_note: Tambaram West and adjacent Mudichur along the Adyar river basin are documented high-risk flood pockets (2015, 2023)

localities.name: Vandalur
localities.price_note: Apartments; plotted land typically ~Rs 2,000-3,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: Growth node at the GST Road-Kelambakkam link and Outer Ring Road junction; appreciation tracks the Guduvancheri-Vandalur belt's 7-10% annual land value growth (locality band partly estimated).
demand_drivers: Outer Ring Road + Vandalur-Kelambakkam Road junction
localities.supply_note: Plotted developments dominant; apartment supply growing

localities.name: Guduvancheri
localities.price_note: Apartments ~Rs 3,800-5,800/sqft; plotted land distinctly lower at ~Rs 1,800-3,500/sqft (April 2025)
localities.trend_note: One of the fastest-growing GST Road suburbs, with 7-10% annual land value appreciation driven by rail connectivity, SRM University and Mahindra World City proximity.
localities.supply_note: Abundant affordable apartment and plot supply; competitive pricing
localities.flood_note: Some low-lying lake-adjacent pockets waterlog in heavy monsoons

localities.name: Singaperumal Koil
localities.price_note: Apartments (limited stock); plotted land roughly Rs 1,500-3,000/sqft is the dominant product
localities.trend_note: Industrial-belt residential node beside Mahindra World City (Ford, BMW, Infosys, SIPCOT nearby); demand driven by industrial employment, with plots the primary asset class.
demand_drivers: Mahindra World City and SIPCOT industrial employment
localities.supply_note: Plot-heavy supply; thin organized apartment market

localities.name: Maraimalai Nagar
localities.price_note: Apartments; plotted land ~Rs 1,500-3,000/sqft
localities.trend_note: Planned satellite township near Mahindra World City and Ford plant corridor; land rates gaining on affordability and industrial demand, tracking the belt's 7-10% annual appreciation.
localities.supply_note: Good availability of plots and mid-income apartments

localities.name: Pallavaram
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 8,400/sqft, transactions ~Rs 8,900/sqft (99acres)
localities.trend_note: Flat rates changed ~18.3% in the last 1 year and ~48.7% over 3 years per 99acres; airport proximity, Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Radial Road and redevelopment are re-rating the market.
localities.supply_note: Tightening land availability in core; new supply along Radial Road and Zamin Pallavaram
localities.flood_note: Pockets around Pallavaram lake/Periyar Nagar waterlog; hillside areas safer

localities.name: Injambakkam-Uthandi (ECR belt)
localities.price_note: Apartments/villas; Injambakkam ~Rs 7,900-9,500/sqft, Uthandi ~Rs 6,500-8,700/sqft; land parcels ~Rs 7,100-10,850/sqft on ECR frontage
localities.trend_note: Lifestyle/second-home villa corridor: Uthandi showed ~11.5% YoY and Injambakkam ~5.6% YoY growth per 99acres-cited data; premium driven by sea proximity and low-density villa plots.
demand_drivers: ECR six-laning and OMR link roads
localities.supply_note: Low-density villa/plot supply; CRZ rules restrict density near coast
localities.flood_note: Coastal/backwater low-lying stretches and Buckingham Canal edge can inundate during cyclonic rain; elevated plots safer

localities.name: Porur
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 8,150/sqft (99acres)
localities.trend_note: Flat rates up ~7.9% in the last year; Metro Phase II Corridor 4 (Poonamallee-Porur stretch trial runs from June 2025) and Mount-Poonamallee Road office growth are key catalysts.
demand_drivers: DLF Downtown / Mount-Poonamallee Road IT offices
localities.supply_note: Strong launch pipeline from major developers; healthy absorption
localities.flood_note: Porur lake-adjacent low-lying pockets waterlog in intense monsoons

localities.name: Poonamallee
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 6,100/sqft (99acres); plots cheaper
localities.trend_note: Flat rates up ~8.9% YoY with a visible surge tied to Metro Phase II Corridor 4 terminus and Outer Ring Road; positioned as west Chennai's next growth hub.
demand_drivers: Outer Ring Road and Bengaluru highway access
localities.supply_note: Rising new supply (apartments and plots); still affordable entry point

localities.name: Mogappair
localities.price_note: Apartments; Mogappair East cited ~Rs 10,850/sqft average
localities.trend_note: Mogappair East rates cited at ~22.6% YoY growth (99acres-derived data); mature planned neighborhood benefiting from Anna Nagar spillover and metro access at Koyambedu/upcoming corridors.
localities.supply_note: Tight land supply in core Mogappair; premium for planned layouts
localities.data_confidence: medium; YoY figure from portal data, may reflect mix change; rental yield estimated

localities.name: Ambattur
localities.price_note: Apartments; Ambattur Industrial Estate area average ~Rs 7,400/sqft
localities.trend_note: About 8.8% YoY price change per 99acres for the Ambattur Industrial Estate micro-market; demand from industrial estate jobs, IT parks (Ambit IT Park) and rail connectivity.
localities.supply_note: Good mid-income supply; steady absorption
localities.flood_note: Lake-belt pockets (Ambattur/Korattur lakes) waterlog in heavy rain

localities.name: Anna Nagar
localities.price_note: Apartments (resale ~Rs 10,000-15,000/sqft); new luxury projects can exceed this
localities.trend_note: Prime planned neighborhood with sustained end-user and NRI demand; steady single-digit appreciation with premium redevelopment activity rather than sharp swings.
demand_drivers: Top schools, hospitals, retail (VR Mall, Shanti Colony)
localities.supply_note: Very tight land supply; mostly plot redevelopment into boutique apartments

localities.name: Kilpauk
localities.price_note: Apartments; 99acres cites ~Rs 15,600/sqft average
localities.trend_note: Central premium locality averaging ~Rs 15,600/sqft with ~4.7% YoY change per 99acres; demand from medical/professional community and central-city scarcity.
demand_drivers: Kilpauk Medical College and hospitals cluster
localities.supply_note: Land-locked; supply only via redevelopment of old bungalows

localities.name: Nungambakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; among Chennai's costliest along with Adyar and T. Nagar
localities.trend_note: Ultra-prime CBD-residential market (Rs 14,000-20,000/sqft) where values are high and steady; transactions are scarce, driven by luxury boutique projects.
demand_drivers: CBD offices, consulates, luxury retail (Khader Nawaz Khan Road)
localities.supply_note: Extremely tight inventory; occasional luxury launches only

localities.name: Adyar
localities.price_note: Apartments; premium pockets (Boat Club side, Besant Nagar edge) higher
localities.trend_note: South Chennai's most sought-after established locality (~Rs 12,000-18,000/sqft); consistent appreciation on scarcity, IT-corridor adjacency and lifestyle amenities.
demand_drivers: Proximity to Tidel Park/Taramani IT hub
Beach/lifestyle (Besant Nagar, Theosophical Society green lung)
localities.supply_note: Tight inventory; redevelopment-driven boutique supply
localities.flood_note: River-mouth fringe streets can waterlog, but core Adyar is relatively resilient

localities.name: Velachery
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 9,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: Capital appreciation of ~13.8% over the past year per portal data; positioned as the gateway between core city and OMR/IT corridor with metro (MRTS + Phase II) connectivity.
demand_drivers: Gateway to OMR IT corridor and Guindy
Strong rental demand from IT workforce
localities.supply_note: Mature market, limited fresh land; redevelopment and infill supply
localities.flood_note: Velachery basin is historically flood-prone (2015, 2023 — Tansi Nagar, Ram Nagar, lake-adjacent pockets rank high risk); elevated eastern/Vijayanagar pockets fare better. Treat low-lying streets as high risk.

localities.name: Pallikaranai
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 7,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: ~7.1% YoY growth per 99acres despite flood stigma, on affordability and IT-corridor access; NGT's Sept 2025 order restraining CMDA approvals within 1 km of the Ramsar marsh boundary will constrain new supply.
demand_drivers: Proximity to OMR and Velachery employment
localities.supply_note: New approvals restricted near marsh (NGT 2025); existing stock substantial
localities.flood_note: Sits on/beside the Pallikaranai marsh; repeatedly and severely inundated (2015, 2023 Michaung); among Chennai's highest documented flood-risk zones

localities.name: Medavakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 7,200/sqft
localities.trend_note: ~7.5% YoY growth per 99acres; a self-sustained mid-income hub equidistant from OMR, GST Road and Velachery via Medavakkam-Sholinganallur Road.
localities.supply_note: Active mid-income supply; marsh-adjacent stretches face NGT approval scrutiny
localities.flood_note: Marsh-adjacent northern stretches are flood-documented; interior elevated pockets moderate

localities.name: Perumbakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; 99acres average ~Rs 6,150/sqft with newer gated-community transactions up to ~Rs 9,400/sqft
localities.trend_note: ~6% price change in the last year and ~20.6% over 3 years per 99acres; large integrated townships serve OMR/Sholinganallur workforce at a discount to the corridor.
localities.supply_note: Heavy township supply; wetland-adjacent land under NGT/regulatory scrutiny
localities.flood_note: Perumbakkam-Semmencheri wetland corridor is documented flood-prone (2015, 2023); ground-floor and low-lying blocks worst affected

localities.name: Sriperumbudur
localities.price_note: Apartments (thin market); the dominant product is plotted land at roughly Rs 1,600-3,500/sqft (DTCP gated plots from ~Rs 1,595/sqft)
localities.trend_note: Industrial powerhouse (electronics/EV/aerospace parks, 20+ Fortune 500 plants) with land appreciation accelerating on the proposed Parandur greenfield airport ~15 minutes away.
demand_drivers: SIPCOT industrial parks (electronics, EV, medical devices, aerospace)
localities.supply_note: Plot supply abundant; organized apartment supply just emerging — verify developer credentials
localities.data_confidence: medium; prices for plots better documented than apartments; rental yield estimated

localities.name: Oragadam
localities.price_note: Apartments/villas in townships (e.g., Hiranandani Parks); plotted land roughly Rs 1,200-2,800/sqft
localities.trend_note: South India's largest auto/industrial corridor (20+ Fortune 500 firms); Rs 300+ crore state connectivity investment along NH-45/NH-4/SH-57 underpins steady land appreciation.
demand_drivers: Automobile & electronics manufacturing employment (Renault-Nissan, Daimler, Apollo Tyres belt)
localities.supply_note: Large plotted and township supply; end-user conversion still maturing

localities.name: Avadi
localities.price_note: Apartments; ~Rs 4,500/sqft average per portal data; plots cheaper
localities.trend_note: Portal data cites ~21.6% YoY change (likely amplified by new-launch mix); genuine drivers are defence establishments (HVF, CVRDE), rail upgrades and west-Chennai metro expansion plans.
demand_drivers: Defence establishments (Heavy Vehicles Factory, CVRDE, OCF)
Suburban rail and proposed metro extension
localities.supply_note: Growing affordable supply; large developer entry recent
localities.flood_note: Some lake-belt pockets waterlog; core areas moderate
localities.data_confidence: medium; YoY figure treated with caution; rental yield estimated

localities.name: Madhavaram
localities.price_note: Apartments ~Rs 7,000-8,450/sqft; land guide rates lower per silversky 2025 guide
localities.trend_note: North Chennai's breakout market: Metro Phase II corridors 3 & 5 originate at Madhavaram, plus NH-16/Chennai Bypass access; portals report strong recent appreciation.
demand_drivers: Metro Phase II twin-corridor origin (Madhavaram Milk Colony)
NH-16 and Chennai Bypass logistics belt
localities.supply_note: New launches accelerating; still early-cycle inventory
localities.flood_note: Parts of the Retteri lake catchment waterlog in heavy rain

localities.name: Manapakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 8,300/sqft (99acres)
localities.trend_note: ~5.1% YoY change per 99acres; office corridor (DLF IT Park, L&T campus on Mount-Poonamallee Road) and Metro Phase II Corridor 4 sustain demand.
demand_drivers: DLF Cybercity/L&T and Mount-Poonamallee Road offices
localities.supply_note: Moderate supply; well absorbed by office workforce
localities.flood_note: Adyar river floodplain edge — 2015-type events inundated riverside stretches

localities.name: Kolathur
localities.price_note: Apartments; ~Rs 7,700/sqft cited average
localities.trend_note: ~8.5% YoY growth per portal data; part of the north-Chennai boom alongside Madhavaram/Korattur, aided by 100-ft Road retail and metro-corridor proximity.
demand_drivers: Proximity to Madhavaram metro hub and Retteri junction
localities.supply_note: Steady mid-income supply; infill-driven
localities.flood_note: Retteri lake catchment pockets waterlog in cyclonic rain

localities.name: Tiruvallur-Ponneri belt
localities.price_note: Predominantly plotted land: Tiruvallur ~Rs 1,800-2,800/sqft (2025) vs Rs 800-1,000 in 2020; Ponneri from ~Rs 1,700/sqft; organized apartments scarce (~Rs 3,500-4,500/sqft where available)
localities.trend_note: Plot values appreciated ~80-120% over five years to 2025 per developer market guides; Peripheral Ring Road, Thirumazhisai satellite township, Ponneri's proximity to Ennore-Kattupalli ports and SIPCOT Thervoy Kandigai drive momentum. Treat developer ROI projections with caution.
demand_drivers: Ennore/Kattupalli port and Gummidipoondi industrial logistics (Ponneri side)
Suburban rail on both Arakkonam and Gummidipoondi lines
localities.supply_note: Abundant plotted supply from organized players (G Square etc.); speculative element — verify DTCP/RERA approvals
localities.flood_note: Mostly elevated agrarian land; isolated tank-bed pockets should be avoided
localities.data_confidence: medium; developer-sourced appreciation figures, plot market with thin rental data

localities.name: Tondiarpet
localities.price_note: Wide variance: older resale stock and independent-house belt trades ₹4,500-6,500/sqft while newer apartment listings average ₹8,900-9,200/sqft; plots ₹3,500-5,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: Steady appreciation since the Blue Line Wimco Nagar metro extension opened (Feb 2021); North Chennai apartment asking rates rose ~19% YoY 2025-26 at corridor level, Tondiarpet participating from a low base
demand_drivers: Operational Blue Line metro stations (Tondiarpet, Toll Gate)
affordable entry prices vs city core
localities.supply_note: Dense, plot-scarce inner-city market; mostly small builder floors and redevelopment of old row housing, resale-dominated with few large gated launches

localities.name: Royapuram
localities.price_note: Square Yards shows average asking price ~₹13,083/sqft but micromarket transaction rates settled near ₹7,984/sqft in Dec 2025 — thin, volatile sample; use lower band for realistic deals
localities.trend_note: Micromarket rates moved from ₹5,948/sqft (Jun 2025) to ₹7,984/sqft (Dec 2025) with a spike to ₹9,898 in Sep 2025; asking prices stable QoQ — volatile but upward-biased
demand_drivers: Chennai Port and Kasimedu fishing harbour employment
heritage core close to George Town wholesale trade
Blue Line metro at Washermanpet nearby
localities.supply_note: Old, congested heritage locality; supply is resale independent houses and small builder-floor redevelopment, very few organised new projects

localities.name: Washermanpet
localities.price_note: Old Washermanpet averages ~₹7,621/sqft; New Washermanpet (metro-served) slightly higher for newer stock
localities.trend_note: Project-level data (Lifestyle Vardaan) moved ₹6,850 to ₹8,400/sqft in Q3 2025 (+22.6%); locality overall tracking North Chennai's ~19% YoY asking-rate rise from a low base
demand_drivers: Blue Line metro stations (Washermanpet, New Washermenpet)
proximity to George Town commercial core and port jobs
localities.supply_note: Resale-dominated dense urban fabric; scattered small-developer apartment projects (e.g. Lifestyle Vardaan), no large township supply

localities.name: Perambur
localities.price_note: 99acres flat range ₹7,250-10,950/sqft (avg ~₹8,400); Square Yards shows ~₹9,500/sqft asking
localities.trend_note: +5% to +14.8% YoY depending on source (99acres +5%/1yr and +29.2%/3yr; Square Yards +14.79%); land values in Perambur-Madhavaram belt reported up 30-60% over two years
demand_drivers: Perambur railway hub (ICF, Loco Works, suburban junction)
Metro Phase 2 Corridor 3 (Madhavaram-SIPCOT) stations under construction
established retail and schools, Anna Nagar-alternative positioning
strong renter interest per portal data
localities.supply_note: Most active organised-supply market in North Chennai: Casagrand Mercury (639 units) and multiple mid-size developer launches alongside deep resale stock of 2-3 BHK apartments

localities.name: Villivakkam
localities.price_note: 99acres flat range ₹5,800-9,600/sqft, avg ~₹6,900; land averages higher (~₹8,550/sqft) reflecting redevelopment value
localities.trend_note: Flat rates corrected -7.4% over the last year after earlier gains (+3% over 3 years, +14% over 10); Metro Corridor 5 stations (Villivakkam belt) should support recovery post-2026
demand_drivers: Metro Phase 2 Corridor 5 alignment through the locality
Anna Nagar / Koyambedu adjacency at a discount
localities.supply_note: Mixed resale apartments and active plot/redevelopment market; small-format builder floors dominate, limited branded launches

localities.name: Korattur
localities.price_note: Square Yards shows ₹9,450/sqft asking; new branded launches priced ~₹6,999/sqft (Casagrand Medora), marketed as half of Anna Nagar rates
localities.trend_note: +35% YoY per Square Yards asking-rate data (likely overstated by mix shift toward new premium launches, but direction clearly strong)
demand_drivers: 10 minutes from Anna Nagar at ~half the price
localities.supply_note: Active new-launch market: Casagrand Medora (155 units) and Casagrand Asta (325 units) plus TNHB-era resale stock; one of North Chennai's few executive-grade supply pockets

localities.name: Padi
localities.price_note: Square Yards ₹8,800/sqft asking vs 99acres avg flat rate ~₹7,000/sqft; band reflects both
localities.trend_note: +15% YoY per Square Yards; benefiting from Anna Nagar West and Ambattur spillover and Metro Corridor 5 works along the Retteri-Thirumangalam belt
demand_drivers: industrial employment (TI Cycles, Britannia belt, Ambattur estate)
Padi flyover junction on Inner Ring Road / CTH Road
Anna Nagar adjacency at lower cost
localities.supply_note: Resale-dominated with mid-size local builder apartments; limited land, some redevelopment of older industrial-worker housing

localities.name: Red Hills
localities.price_note: Plotted-development market: 99acres avg flat and land rates ~₹2,500/sqft with plot listings at ₹3,000-3,500/sqft; very few apartments — band is an apartment-equivalent estimate
localities.trend_note: North Chennai home registrations surged 88% in Q1 2025; land values along Outer/Peripheral Ring Road connectors rising rapidly from a very low base
demand_drivers: NH-16 (Kolkata highway) and Outer Ring Road connectivity
Metro Corridor 5 terminus at Madhavaram within reach
localities.supply_note: Dominated by DTCP/CMDA-approved villa-plot layouts (400+ plot listings vs a handful of apartments); speculative land-banking market

localities.name: Manali
localities.price_note: 99acres avg apartment rate ~₹3,450/sqft; Manali New Town 2BHK (~900 sqft) around ₹31 lakh
localities.trend_note: Apartment prices moved -1.4% over the last year; industrial employment supports demand but pollution and flood history cap appreciation
demand_drivers: Manali New Town TNHB housing stock
Metro Phase 2 Corridor 5 branch toward Manali/Thiruvottiyur planned
lowest apartment prices in the CMA core
localities.supply_note: TNHB Manali New Town stock plus small local-builder apartments and land parcels; industrial-cum-residential character, minimal branded supply

localities.name: Ennore
localities.price_note: Corridor-level estimate: plot listings ₹3,875-6,700/sqft (Ennore/Ernavur) but organised apartment market is nearly absent; apartment-equivalent band kept conservative
localities.trend_note: Port/industrial employment underpins baseline demand, but Dec 2023 CPCL oil spill (24,000 L into Buckingham Canal/Ennore Creek), fly ash accumulation and 30+ red-category industries create a livability discount; no reliable YoY apartment series
demand_drivers: Blue Line metro terminus at Wimco Nagar nearby
localities.supply_note: Plot layouts and modest independent housing; effectively no branded apartment supply — thin, occupier-driven market

localities.name: Moolakadai
localities.price_note: 99acres avg flat rate ~₹8,550/sqft but recent transactions ranged ₹4,761-7,436/sqft on a very small sample; wide variance, thin market
localities.trend_note: +74.5% over 10 years per 99acres; junction location on the Madhavaram-Perambur growth belt with Metro Corridor 3 (Moolakadai station) under construction, Madhavaram-Retteri stretch of Corridor 5 targeted for mid-2026 opening nearby
demand_drivers: Metro Phase 2 Corridor 3 station at Moolakadai
major arterial junction (GNT Road / Inner Ring Road / 200 Feet Road)
localities.supply_note: Thin organised supply — a handful of small apartments, builder floors and plots; mostly self-built housing awaiting metro-led redevelopment

localities.name: Vyasarpadi
localities.price_note: Estimated from 99acres listings: 2BHK ₹52-66L and 3BHK ₹74.5-80.5L on 625-1,025 sqft units (~₹6,000-8,000/sqft for newer small-format stock); older housing trades lower — no published locality rate series
localities.trend_note: No reliable YoY series; benefits modestly from Perambur adjacency and Corridor 3 metro works but socio-economic profile and flood history keep appreciation muted
demand_drivers: industrial and logistics employment (Madhavaram trucking belt)
lowest-cost formal apartments in inner North Chennai
localities.supply_note: Resale small-format flats (~70 resale listings) and TNUHDB/slum-board redevelopment stock; minimal private branded supply

localities.name: Saligramam
localities.price_note: Avg flat rate ~Rs 10,750/sqft; land/plot rates Rs 11,750-19,550/sqft (99acres, 2026)
localities.trend_note: Flat rates +3.4% in last 1 year, +16.2% in 3 years, +61.7% in 10 years — mature Arcot Road market appreciating slowly off a high base
demand_drivers: Metro Phase 2 Corridor 4 (Vadapalani-Poonamallee stretch cleared safety inspection May 2026, opening imminent)
Arcot Road retail and film/media employment around Vadapalani
proximity to Kodambakkam and T Nagar
localities.supply_note: Largely built-out; supply is small infill apartment projects and redevelopment of older independent houses

localities.name: Virugambakkam
localities.price_note: Avg flat rate ~Rs 11,300/sqft; land rates up to ~Rs 18,350/sqft (99acres, 2026)
localities.trend_note: Flat rates +20.2% in last 1 year, +48.7% in 5 years — strongest 1-yr jump on the Arcot Road belt, ahead of Corridor 4 opening
demand_drivers: Metro Phase 2 Corridor 4 station on Arcot Road (Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch ready, opening pending mid-2026)
proximity to Koyambedu CMBT and Vadapalani
localities.supply_note: Infill mid-rise apartments; limited land parcels driving redevelopment premiums

localities.name: Valasaravakkam

localities.name: Semmancheri
localities.price_note: Avg ~₹7,850/sqft; large gated communities dominate
localities.trend_note: +13.8% YoY (99acres); OMR corridor overall ~₹7,300/sqft
demand_drivers: Sholinganallur/ELCOT IT SEZ employment within 10 min
Metro Phase 2 Corridor 3 (Madhavaram-SIPCOT) alignment along OMR
localities.supply_note: Heavy big-developer supply pipeline; tenant-to-owner conversions strong; low-lying stretches west of OMR flooded during Cyclone Michaung 2023

localities.name: Egattur
localities.price_note: Avg ~₹10,800/sqft — premium end of lower OMR (Hiranandani, Casagrand cluster)
localities.trend_note: 99acres shows +1.9% recent YoY on avg rate but flat rates +19.8% over last 1 year across the pocket
demand_drivers: Township-grade stock (Hiranandani Egattur) with sea-facing towers
Between Sholinganallur and SIPCOT Siruseri job nodes
Metro Phase 2 terminal stretch to SIPCOT
localities.supply_note: High-rise township supply concentrated in a few large developers; premium to surrounding Navalur

localities.name: Perungudi
localities.price_note: Avg ~₹11,050/sqft
localities.trend_note: +11.1% YoY apartment prices (99acres)
demand_drivers: Upper OMR IT belt (RMZ Millenia, Prestige Cyber Towers catchment)
Highest average rents on corridor (~₹45,000/month per NoBroker)
localities.supply_note: Dense mid-rise supply, limited large parcels; eastern edge abuts Perungudi dump/Pallikaranai marsh — waterlogging-prone streets in interior pockets

localities.name: Taramani
localities.price_note: Avg transaction rate ~₹12,820/sqft (registration data); new projects ₹8,000-11,000/sqft
localities.trend_note: IT-corridor yields 3-4.5%; corridor-leading rents; steady appreciation with Perungudi/Thiruvanmiyur pulling rates up
demand_drivers: Tidel Park, Ascendas ITPC, CSIR campus employment at doorstep
Institutional belt (Anna University, IIT-M research park nearby)
localities.supply_note: Very limited developable land; small premium projects command scarcity pricing

localities.name: Thiruvanmiyur
localities.price_note: Avg ~₹14,500/sqft; beach-side (Kalakshetra Colony, RTO area) commands the top of band
localities.trend_note: ~+13.7% YoY average apartment movement (99acres)
demand_drivers: Senior IT/expat rental demand; strongest lifestyle-address on OMR mouth
localities.supply_note: Redevelopment-only market; chronic scarcity of new stock keeps premiums high

localities.name: Besant Nagar
localities.price_note: Avg ~₹20,900/sqft; Elliot's Beach-front streets well above band top
localities.trend_note: +28.2% YoY average apartment prices (99acres) — Chennai's most coveted beachfront enclave
demand_drivers: Old-money + CXO end-user demand, near-zero vacancy
localities.supply_note: Effectively no new land; only boutique redevelopment of old TNHB-era plots; scarcity-driven pricing

localities.name: Kottivakkam
localities.price_note: Avg ~₹14,850/sqft; beach-side (east of ECR) villas ₹4-10 Cr
localities.trend_note: +19.3% YoY average apartment prices (99acres)
demand_drivers: First beach suburb south of Thiruvanmiyur — OMR offices 10 min
Beach-side villa/floor-space demand from senior professionals
localities.supply_note: Boutique luxury apartments and villa redevelopments; very limited beach-side plots left

localities.name: Palavakkam
localities.price_note: Avg flat rate ~₹12,250/sqft (99acres range ₹7,100-12,500); beach-side villa plots ₹15,000+/sqft
localities.trend_note: Double-digit annual appreciation in line with Kottivakkam-Neelankarai belt (+16-19% YoY)
demand_drivers: Beach lifestyle with OMR employment 10-15 min
localities.supply_note: Mix of old village core (west of ECR, cheaper) and premium beach-side; small-format luxury supply only

localities.name: Neelankarai
localities.price_note: Avg ~₹13,950/sqft; beach-side villas ₹3.5-12 Cr
localities.trend_note: +16.3% apartment price movement over last one year (99acres)
demand_drivers: Beach-villa belt favored by CXOs/film industry
localities.supply_note: Villa redevelopment and low-rise luxury apartments; backwater-adjacent western pockets low-lying

localities.name: Karapakkam
localities.price_note: Avg ~₹9,350/sqft (registration-data avg ₹9,379)
localities.trend_note: +19.1% in last 1 year, +43.8% over 3 years (99acres)
demand_drivers: Mid-OMR position between Thoraipakkam and Sholinganallur IT hubs
localities.supply_note: Steady mid-rise supply; Okkiyam Maduvu drainage channel borders the west — 2015/2023 flooding memory keeps buyers to east-of-OMR stock

localities.name: Thalambur
localities.trend_note: +6.5% to +7.4% YoY (99acres) — slower than OMR frontage but steady
demand_drivers: Large gated-community stock at value pricing
localities.supply_note: Ample supply from mid-size developers; competition from Navalur/Siruseri caps pricing power

localities.name: Akkarai
localities.price_note: Apartments ~₹10,600-11,700/sqft; villa plots avg ~₹11,450/sqft, beach-side plots ₹2.7-15 Cr; villas from ~₹2 Cr
localities.trend_note: +5.9% YoY (99acres ECR-Akkarai); broader ECR ~+20.7% YoY at ₹9,050/sqft avg
demand_drivers: Beach villa enclave nearest to Sholinganallur IT hub (via ECR-OMR link)
localities.supply_note: Predominantly villa plots and boutique villa projects; very limited apartment stock

localities.name: Panaiyur
localities.price_note: Apartments avg ~₹11,450/sqft; villa plots ₹10,400-14,400/sqft (beachfront top of band); luxury beach villas ₹5 Cr+
localities.trend_note: +18.0% YoY apartment prices (99acres)
demand_drivers: Prime ECR beach-villa micro-market (film industry, promoters)
Approved plotted layouts scarce east of ECR
localities.supply_note: Villa plots and independent-house market; 96+ plot listings; minimal apartment development

localities.name: Muttukadu
localities.price_note: Villa/plot market: land ₹2,500-5,000/sqft depending on backwater vs ECR frontage; branded villa communities ₹1.5-6 Cr; large patta parcels trade wholesale (e.g. 20 grounds at ₹42 Cr on 100ft road)
localities.trend_note: ECR belt overall +20.7% YoY (99acres); Muttukadu lifted by boat-house tourism node and Kovalam bridge upgrades
localities.supply_note: Plotted layouts and gated villa projects; backwater-edge parcels face CRZ and drainage constraints

localities.name: Kovalam (ECR)
localities.price_note: Primarily plot/villa market: approved sea-side plots ~₹4,500/sqft, interior ₹3,000-3,500/sqft (1,000 sqft plots ~₹33 L, 2,400 sqft ~₹85 L); surf-tourism cottages and villas
localities.trend_note: Strong plot appreciation on ECR belt (+20%+ YoY corridor-wide); Kovalam boosted by surf-school tourism circuit and Muttukadu bridge
demand_drivers: Adventure-tourism and resort development on ECR
localities.supply_note: Village core plus plotted layouts; CRZ limits beach-side construction; supply mostly land, few formal projects

localities.name: Thiruvidandhai
localities.price_note: Villa/plot belt: layout plots ~₹1,800-3,500/sqft, ECR-frontage higher; active villa projects (Olympia Reflection, GT Bharathi Republic of Nature, Broadstone Amaram) and 60-acre BoatClub plotted development
localities.trend_note: Emerging villa-project cluster; ECR corridor +20.7% YoY average lifts the belt, though absolute rates remain the lowest on this list
demand_drivers: Branded villa/plotted projects between Kovalam and Mahabalipuram
ECR six-laning and Mahabalipuram tourism corridor
localities.supply_note: Plentiful land supply; multiple new villa/plot launches — appreciation depends on project execution and CRZ-compliant approvals

localities.name: Urapakkam
localities.price_note: Apartment rates (established mid-budget apartment market on GST Road). Plotted layouts on Vandalur–Kelambakkam Rd fringe trade lower, ~3000–4500/sqft.
localities.trend_note: 99acres shows ~20.8% flat-rate appreciation in the last year; spillover demand from Vandalur/Guduvancheri, Kilambakkam bus terminus and Vandalur zoo-belt connectivity upgrades.
localities.supply_note: Heavy new apartment and plotted supply between Urapakkam and Guduvancheri; absorption decent but launch pipeline is large — price discovery still driven by end-users rather than investors.

localities.name: Potheri
localities.price_note: Apartment rates (student/faculty-driven apartment market around SRM). 99acres weighted average ~₹3,600/sqft; plots near campus ~3,100–5,600/sqft.
localities.trend_note: ~22% y-o-y apartment price movement per 99acres; SRM expansion and GST Road corridor momentum.
demand_drivers: SRM Institute of Science & Technology campus (student rentals)
localities.supply_note: Steady small-builder apartment supply aimed at rental investors; occupancy tied to academic cycle — rental market is deep for a periphery location but resale liquidity is thinner.

localities.name: Kattankulathur
localities.price_note: Apartment rates; 99acres average ~₹3,800/sqft with strong dispersion — gated-community and villa pockets near SRM price well above the band midpoint.
localities.trend_note: ~28.8% y-o-y apartment price change per 99acres — one of the strongest movers on GST Road; SRM ecosystem plus Mahindra World City employment.
demand_drivers: Peripheral Ring Road Section 4 (Sriperumbudur–Singaperumalkoil) operational nearby
localities.supply_note: Growing gated-community and plotted supply; the sharp one-year price jump warrants caution on entry pricing — some listings appear to front-run infrastructure completion.

localities.name: Chengalpattu town
localities.price_note: Apartment asking rates (Square Yards avg ~₹6,588/sqft Mar-2026 is asking-price-skewed; transacted mid-market apartments and under-construction stock nearer ₹4,500–6,150). Plots in outlying layouts far cheaper.
localities.trend_note: Cooling after a mid-2025 peak (₹7,001 Jun-2025 → ₹6,588 Mar-2026 per Square Yards); long-term supported by district-HQ status, rail junction and PRR southern sections.
demand_drivers: Mahindra World City and Maraimalai Nagar industrial belt
Peripheral Ring Road southern sections (Singaperumalkoil–Mamallapuram leg targeted end-2026)
localities.supply_note: Moderate apartment supply in town; very large speculative plotted supply on all approach roads (Kolavai belt, GST Road south) — plotted asking rates vary wildly and oversupply risk is real outside the town core.

localities.name: Thiruporur
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates — no meaningful apartment market yet. ~₹2,600/sqft typical DTCP plots, on-OMR frontage and premium gated layouts up to ~₹4,800/sqft.
localities.trend_note: ~18.2% y-o-y per portal data; OMR IT-corridor extension southward and PRR/ECR linkage expectations driving plotted demand.
demand_drivers: Peripheral Ring Road terminus corridor toward Poonjeri
localities.supply_note: Speculative plotted oversupply is significant — dozens of G Square-style branded and small-promoter layouts; end-user construction density remains low, so exit depends on continued corridor momentum.

localities.name: Mamallapuram
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates in gated DTCP layouts around Poonjeri junction and inland side of ECR (~₹1,495–2,400/sqft); ECR-front and beach-proximate land trades far higher (portal ECR band up to ~₹10,000+/sqft) but is a distinct luxury land market.
localities.trend_note: Poonjeri is the southern terminus of the 132.87 km Peripheral Ring Road (Singaperumalkoil–Mamallapuram section targeted end-2026), plus steady tourism/second-home demand.
demand_drivers: Peripheral Ring Road terminus at Poonjeri
UNESCO heritage tourism and hospitality economy
localities.supply_note: Plotted supply around Poonjeri has multiplied ahead of PRR completion — heavy speculative layering; heritage-zone (ASI) and CRZ restrictions limit buildable stock near monuments and coast, which supports inland layout pricing but restricts use.

localities.name: Padappai
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates — this is a plot-dominated market (₹1,000–1,500/sqft in outlying promotional layouts up to ~₹2,500/sqft near Padappai junction/Oragadam highway); negligible apartment stock.
localities.trend_note: Demand tied to Oragadam auto belt; heavy promotional discounting (₹1,500/sqft 'first 10 bookings' offers) signals supply pressure rather than price strength.
localities.supply_note: Classic speculative plotted oversupply zone — hundreds of layouts (400+ plot listings on 99acres alone), low construction density, aggressive teaser pricing. Buy only DTCP/RERA layouts near the junction and expect long holding periods.

localities.name: Walajabad
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates — purely plotted/individual-house market, no apartment stock.
localities.trend_note: Was riding Parandur-airport speculation (site was ~15 km north); the TVK government's June 2026 cancellation of the Parandur airport removes that catalyst — expect speculative plot pricing to deflate while genuine Oragadam-worker demand persists.
localities.supply_note: Airport-speculation-era layouts now face an overhang after the June 2026 Parandur cancellation; oversupply of low-priced DTCP plots relative to end-user demand. High caution on resale liquidity.

localities.name: Kanchipuram town
localities.price_note: Plotted/individual-house rates — apartment market is negligible. Town-fringe layouts (e.g. Seeyati ₹2,200–2,500/sqft, +29.4% y-o-y); outlying blocks like Uthiramerur/Mevalurkuppam at ₹950–1,400/sqft; prime town streets above the band.
localities.trend_note: Steady temple-town/end-user economy plus Sriperumbudur–Oragadam industrial spillover; largely insulated from the Parandur cancellation (airport speculation was concentrated in villages north-east of town), though sentiment in that pocket has cooled.
localities.supply_note: Moderate, mostly end-user-driven supply in town; speculative plotted layouts concentrated on approach roads — the sharp fringe-layout appreciation (~29% y-o-y) may partly reflect thin transaction volumes.

localities.name: Ponneri
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates (typical DTCP layouts ~₹1,200–1,800/sqft, listings up to ~₹2,200 near town/station); apartment market negligible.
localities.trend_note: Long-touted smart-city/satellite-town candidate; near-term catalyst is PRR Section 1 (Ennore–Thatchur) which is the most delayed section (completion pushed to 2027) — pricing is holding rather than running.
demand_drivers: Ennore and Kattupalli ports / L&T shipyard employment
localities.supply_note: Large inventory of budget plotted layouts sold on port/PRR narrative; construction density low and the PRR northern-section delay to 2027 stretches the speculative holding period.

localities.name: Gummidipoondi
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates (budget DTCP layouts from ~₹900/sqft; branded RERA-approved villa-plot projects asking ~₹2,275/sqft); no apartment market.
localities.trend_note: Modest appreciation on industrial-employment demand from SIPCOT Gummidipoondi; cheapest organized-industrial-anchor market in the CMA periphery.
demand_drivers: Ennore–Kattupalli port logistics belt to the south-east
localities.supply_note: Very large raw plotted inventory (7,000+ listings on OLX alone) — worker-housing demand is real but absorbable supply is a fraction of what is marketed; steep quality/price dispersion between approved and patta layouts.

localities.name: Minjur
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates (99acres band ₹1,100–2,100/sqft); tiny apartment segment averages ~₹1,100/sqft — effectively a plot market.
localities.trend_note: Land rates down ~18.5% in the last year and ~26.7% over three years per 99acres — flood memory (2015, 2023), industrial-pollution perception and stalled local catalysts outweigh port-proximity demand for now.
demand_drivers: Kattupalli port / L&T shipyard and Ennore port employment
localities.supply_note: Cheap plotted supply exceeds demand; a contrarian value play only for long-horizon buyers who verify elevation — most layouts trade below their 2022 peaks.

localities.name: Pattabiram
localities.price_note: Plotted/individual-house rates (~₹2,850/sqft average, +14% y-o-y); small budget-apartment presence but plots dominate.
localities.trend_note: Avadi-corporation belt momentum — defence-establishment employment, suburban rail and Avadi's overall ~₹3,850/sqft land average pulling Pattabiram up.
localities.supply_note: Balanced by periphery standards — genuine end-user (defence/government employee) demand absorbs supply better than farther-west stations; still, new layouts toward Nazarethpet are speculative.

localities.name: Thirunindravur
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates (99acres average ~₹2,200/sqft for both land and the few flats); effectively a plot-and-individual-house market.
localities.trend_note: Modest steady appreciation as Avadi-belt affordability spillover moves west along the rail line.
demand_drivers: Avadi defence-belt employment to the east
Affordable individual-house demand from Chennai workforce
localities.supply_note: Numerous small DTCP layouts around the lake and station; supply comfortably exceeds near-term end-user demand — prefer station-walkable positions.

localities.name: Veppampattu
localities.price_note: Budget-apartment rates per 99acres (₹3,350–4,300/sqft) — a thin but real affordable-flat market exists near the station; plotted land trades at ₹1,750–2,950/sqft (avg ~₹2,000) and dominates volumes.
localities.trend_note: Affordable end-user market anchored to the railway station; appreciation modest and volume-driven rather than speculative.
demand_drivers: Veppampattu suburban railway station (high EMU frequency)
Lowest-ticket organized housing on the Arakkonam line
localities.supply_note: Long-standing oversupply of tiny budget plots and low-rise flats; 2015 flood memory still discounts lake-adjacent stock — station-proximate, elevated plots hold value best.

localities.name: Sevvapet
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates (99acres band ₹850–2,700/sqft, average ~₹2,000; promotional farm-adjacent layouts advertised as low as ₹550–650/sqft) — no apartment market.
localities.trend_note: Thin, promoter-driven market; the wide price dispersion reflects marketing rather than a unified trend.
demand_drivers: Ultra-low-ticket plot demand from Chennai savers
localities.supply_note: Speculative plotted oversupply is severe — sub-₹1,000/sqft teaser layouts far from the station with little resale market; treat advertised rates skeptically and stay within walkable distance of the rail line.

localities.name: Nemilicheri (Avadi side)
localities.price_note: Plotted-land rates (current listings ₹2,800/sqft for standard plots up to ₹4,600/sqft for CMDA/RERA-approved stock; Avadi-belt land average ~₹3,850/sqft) — apartments scarce.
localities.trend_note: Rides the Avadi corporation corridor's appreciation; CMDA-approved layouts command a clear premium over patta plots.
demand_drivers: Avadi defence establishments (HVF, CVRDE, OFT) employment
localities.supply_note: Moderate supply; better end-user absorption than the far-west stations because of defence-employment demand, but approval-status dispersion (CMDA vs patta) creates a two-tier market.

localities.name: Manavalan Nagar (Tiruvallur)
localities.price_note: Plotted/individual-house rates — Tiruvallur-town-fringe suburb; listings run from ~₹1,500/sqft in outer layouts to ~₹3,300/sqft (e.g. 800 sqft plot at ₹26.4 lakh) near the station/town side. No apartment market of note.
localities.trend_note: Benefits from Tiruvallur district-HQ growth and suburban-rail access; appreciation steady but volumes thin.
demand_drivers: Manavalan Nagar suburban railway station (adjacent to Tiruvallur)
localities.supply_note: Mixed end-user and speculative supply; town-fringe positions absorb well, but outer promotional layouts share the Sevvapet-belt oversupply problem.
